item.title: ADL: Antisemitic assaults in US hit record high in 2025 as overall incidents declined
item.description:
In a year with 203 violent incidents, including the murders of three Jews, the total number of incidents dropped 33% from 2024's record high

The post ADL: Antisemitic assaults in US hit record high in 2025 as overall incidents declined appeared first on The Times of Israel.
